item.title: Things Not Copacetic Between Local H And Boutique Label That Beat Them To As Good As Dead Reissue
item.description: Up until recently, Local H's breakout sophomore album As Good As Dead was extremely hard to come by on vinyl, going for upwards of $200 on secondary markets. This year marks As Good As Dead's 30th anniversary, so it's primed for a reissue; earlier this month, the Long Island-based boutique record label Enjoy The Ride announced that they were doing just that. item.title: Brittany Howard Covers Tina Turner With The St. Louis Symphony Orchestra
item.description: There aren't too many singers who have voices big enough to cover the late Tina Turner without embarrassing themselves, but Brittany Howard is one of them. On Sunday night, Howard took part in the St. Louis Symphony Orchestra's tribute to Turner at St. Louis' Jack C. Taylor Music Center. Turner famously came from Nutbush, Tennessee, but she got her start singing in St. Louis nightclubs. item.title: Legendary Pop Songwriter Billy Steinberg Dead At 74
item.description: Billy Steinberg, a pop songwriter behind a startling number of classic hits, has passed away. Steinberg helped write huge hits for artists like Madonna, Cyndi Lauper, the Bangles, Whitney Houston, Heart, and the Pretenders, and he was still penning big songs into the 21st century. Billboard reports that Steinberg died today after a battle with cancer. He was 74. The post Legendary Pop Songwriter Billy Steinberg Dead At 74 appeared first on Stereogum.
